p.small: high-dimensional observational data → heterogeneous treatment effects · goal: estimate τ(x) without regularization bias

span.p:
Meta-learners · §3
S: one model (regularization bias) · T: two models (no sharing) · X: four stages (propensity-weighted blending)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
Causal trees / forests · §4
honest estimation → unbiased + valid CIs · ensemble → low variance · interpretable

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
Deep representation · §5
TarNet: implicit balance · CFRNet: explicit IPM (distributional balance)

span.p:
DML framework · §6–8
partialing out (remove confounders) · Neyman orthogonality (bias → O(δ²)) · cross-fitting (prevent overfitting)
